pr_title: Add S3 to Azure Blob Transfer Operator
pr_body:
Closes: #31449 

Allows data to be moved from an S3 bucket to Azure blob storage. 

Code changes:
1. `airflow/providers/microsoft/azure/transfers/s3_to_azure_blob.py` - Implements `S3ToAzureBlob` class 

Tests added:
1. `tests/providers/microsoft/azure/transfers/test_s3_to_azure_blob.py` - Unit tests for `S3ToAzureBlob`
2. `tests/system/providers/microsoft/azure/example_s3_to_azure_blob.py` - System tests

Documentation added at `docs/apache-airflow-providers-microsoft-azure/operators/s3_to_azure_blob.rst`

issue_context.title: S3ToAzureBlob Transfer Operator
issue_context.body:
### Description

A useful operation would be to move data from an S3 Bucket to an Azure Blob Storage. Azure is able to support this kind of transfer, as seen [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-ref-azcopy-copy?toc=%2Fazure%2Fstorage%2Fblobs%2Ftoc.json). As seen from this post [here](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/69893676/apache-airflow-operator-to-transfer-data-files-from-s3-to-azure-blob), there are people who would find this functionality useful. 


### Use case/motivation

Currently, Airflow support Azure transfers such blob to gcs, local to data lake, etc. However, there is no support for moving data from an S3 Bucket to Azure Blob storage.

Would this operator be more suited in the `airflow/providers/amazon/aws/transfers/` directory? I wasn't able to pick up rules describing where a cross-cloud operator should go. That being said, there are two reasons I believe that this operator should be in the `airflow/providers/amazon/aws/transfers` directory:

1. There are very few operators in the `airflow/providers/microsoft/azure/transfers/` directory.
2. There is a corresponding `AzureBlobStorageToS3Operator` in the `airflow/providers/amazon/aws/transfers/` directory.

Thanks!

review_comments: Any thoughts on what could be template fields for this operator? Maybe `s3_bucket`, `s3_key`, `container_name`, and `blob_name`? Might be beneficial with some use cases especially those where these args are outputs of previous tasks.

What do you think about making `blob_name` an optional arg? Basically if `blob_name` is not provided then use `s3_key`. It's quite possible users would want to simply copy from one storage service to another and keep the same naming.
`sys_test_context_task `is a util we use to run our system tests. You dont have to use it (if you want, you are welcome to use it tho).
